meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 这个技能把个人微信接入 Claude。扫码登录并配好接线后,别人给你的微信号发消息,Claude 就能自动回复;单聊和群聊都支持,无需公网回调地址。
howto.when: 当你想把个人微信接到 Claude 上让它收发微信消息,或说出“添加微信通道”“配置微信机器人”等要求时,就会用到这个技能。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接到 Claude 上
say.note: 会开始安装微信适配器并提示你扫码。

say.text: 配置微信通道并显示登录二维码,我来扫
say.note: 会修改 .env、重启服务,把二维码给你扫。

say.text: 把微信刚收到的消息接到指定的 agent 组
say.note: 会运行 wire-dm 脚本完成接线。

howto.what_en: Adds a personal WeChat channel to Claude: after install, QR login, and wiring to an agent group, messages sent to that WeChat account (DMs and group chats) are received in real time by long-poll and Claude can answer. No webhook or paid token needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to connect their personal WeChat to Claude, add a WeChat channel, or configure a WeChat bot, or chooses WeChat as a channel during setup.

say_en.text: Connect my personal WeChat to Claude.
say_en.note: It installs the adapter and asks you to scan a QR.

say_en.text: Enable the WeChat channel and show me the QR code.
say_en.note: It changes .env, restarts the service, and shows the QR.

say_en.text: Wire the latest WeChat DM I received to an agent group.
say_en.note: It runs wire-dm.ts to create the wiring.
